messages:
Sam W: Hey devs — running into weird pagination + client throttle interaction in sampleapp. When we hit 429s the paginator replays the same cursor and we end up processing duplicate pages. Anyone seen this?
Anya R: Oof. Which SDK? js or go?
Sam W: JS. using SDK v0.7.3 sampleapp: https://github.com/redwood/sampleapps/backpressure-probe
Mike L: I remember a similar thing — retries + page token mutation race. If retry replays the request after page token was advanced locally you can double-process.
Lee: Can you paste the loop? probably doing `while (hasNext) { await fetchNext(); }` without locking.
Sam W: Here's minimal snippet:

Sam W: ```js
const p = client.paginate({model:'x', pageSize:50});
for await (const page of p) {
  await throttle.send(page.items)
}
```
Anya R: Ah — `throttle.send` is async and can trigger 429 which causes the SDK to retry the last request. Meanwhile the iterator advanced. SDK retry doesn't re-sync the iterator cursor.
Jordan: Yeah, JS SDK retries at transport layer; iterator state is higher-level. We tried a fix in internal branch: make retries happen before advancing the cursor or expose a per-page ack hook.
Mike L: Is Go behavior different? We need SDK parity on backpressure hooks.
Anya R: Go currently exposes `PageAck(ctx, token)` but JS doesn't. That's the gap.
Sam W: Workaround for now: set client config `retry.on429: false` and handle retries in app-level with transactional ack.
Lee: Also you can reduce `maxConcurrency` and use a bounded channel to process pages.
Jordan: I'll open a tiny PR to add `pageAck` callback to JS paginator and a note in sampleapp docs.
Anya R: +1. Also add a small test that simulates delayed throttle and 429s.
ci-bot: build / sampleapps/backpressure -> failed (flaky test) :red_circle:
Sam W: Thanks — tagging @devex for docs update. I'll add a sample showing `retry.on429=false` pattern.
Mike L: Can we add a note in onboarding guide warning about combining auto-retries and iterator-style pagination?
Anya R: Yes. I'll add a short paragraph and code snippet.
Jordan: PR: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-js/pull/432 — adding `onPageAck` hook. pls review.
Sam W: Nice. Assigning follow-ups: Sam -> update sampleapp readme; Jordan -> PR; Anya -> docs; Mike -> add test. :thumbsup:
Lee: Cool. If anyone wants a quick pairing session lmk.
Sam W: Thanks all.
